_doc: A plain M3 hex nut (ISO 4032, as DIN 934) in the slot of OpenBeam, which is made to capture one, so no special T-nut is needed. It slides in from an open end of the slot, flats against the slot's walls. Sizes are the standard nut's, from the kit's m3 thread set; its hold in aluminium is not published.
name: slot-nut-3-openbeam-m3-hex

slot.rule: OpenBeam's slots are "designed to capture a regular DIN934 M3 nut"
slot.source: OpenBeam USA, "About" page as the Internet Archive saved it on 2017-07-16, http://www.openbeamusa.com/about/

thread.rule: Thread M3, the nut OpenBeam names
thread.source: OpenBeam USA, "About" page as the Internet Archive saved it on 2017-07-16, http://www.openbeamusa.com/about/

nut_kind.rule: A plain hexagon nut, held from turning by its flats against the slot's walls
nut_kind.source: OpenBeam USA, "About" page as the Internet Archive saved it on 2017-07-16, http://www.openbeamusa.com/about/

length.rule: Along the slot: across the nut's corners, 5.5 across its flats over cos 30 degrees
length.source: m3.nut_flats (ISO 4032, ISO 4032 (hexagon regular nuts, style 1), as tabulated at https://www.fasteners.eu/standards/ISO/4032/ and https://fasten.it/norms/norm/din_en_iso_4032 (DIN EN ISO 4032:2013-04), and in the standard's own table 1 (ISO 4032:1999) at https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/26382/0f8d850e82f741f5b13e5ed78b236426/ISO-4032-1999.pdf)

width.rule: Across the slot: across its flats
width.source: m3.nut_flats (ISO 4032, ISO 4032 (hexagon regular nuts, style 1), as tabulated at https://www.fasteners.eu/standards/ISO/4032/ and https://fasten.it/norms/norm/din_en_iso_4032 (DIN EN ISO 4032:2013-04), and in the standard's own table 1 (ISO 4032:1999) at https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/26382/0f8d850e82f741f5b13e5ed78b236426/ISO-4032-1999.pdf)

height.source: m3.nut_height (ISO 4032, ISO 4032 (hexagon regular nuts, style 1), as tabulated at https://www.fasteners.eu/standards/ISO/4032/ and https://fasten.it/norms/norm/din_en_iso_4032 (DIN EN ISO 4032:2013-04), and in the standard's own table 1 (ISO 4032:1999) at https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/26382/0f8d850e82f741f5b13e5ed78b236426/ISO-4032-1999.pdf)

nut_entry.rule: Wider than the slot's opening across its flats, so it slides in from an open end

material.source: ISO 4032 property class 8 steel nuts, as sold

hold.rule: Half Rexroth's T-nut in a 6 mm slot (M4, 1700 N): a smaller nut under thinner lips (1.41 mm). An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): OpenBeam gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; slot-3-openbeam.lip_thickness
